# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 06 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale: Records Keep Falling

- **Million-dollar HDB resales hit third straight monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats transacted at S$1 million or above in October 2026, up from 209 in September and 201 in August, representing 10.9% of October's total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)

- **First S$1.8M HDB resale flat recorded — a 5-room unit at SkyParc @ Dawson, Queenstown** - The flat sold for S$1.818 million, crossing the S$1.8 million mark for the first time in Singapore's HDB resale history and setting a new record on both absolute price and price per square foot. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)

- **Kallang Trivista 4-room flat sets new town record at S$1.32M** - The flat sold for S$1.32 million, establishing a new price record for the Kallang/Whampoa town despite being on a lower floor than the previous record holder. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/four-room-flat-kallang-trivista-sold/)

- **Tampines executive flat sells for S$1.275M, becoming town's second priciest HDB resale** - An executive flat at Tampines Palmspring changed hands for S$1.275 million, setting a new price record for executive flats in Tampines across that flat type. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/tampines-palmspring-executive-flat-record-1-275-million/)

## November 2026 BTO Launch

- **HDB launches 7,964 BTO flats across seven projects — final exercise of the year** - The launch covers projects in Bedok, Geylang, Sembawang, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun, with waiting times of 34 to 45 months and 4-room flats starting from S$312,000; it is also the first launch under the higher income ceilings for families, with applications open until 11 November 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-launch-highlights/)

## Commercial & Industrial Transactions

- **Freehold Tai Seng industrial building sells en bloc for S$121.8M — 16% above guide price** - 153 Kampong Ampat, a freehold B1 industrial building in Tai Seng, drew competitive bidding before closing at S$121.8 million, well above its guide price. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/freehold-tai-seng-industrial-building-draws/)
